caption: The drawing features a geometric and floral quilt design rendered in pink, green, red, and white colors. At the center is a large stylized flower with dark pink and light pink petals, a yellow center, and green leaves radiating outward. The background consists of curved feather-like patterns and a repeated scallop motif in pale gray. There are two wide pink arcs forming part of the border. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller image of the same quilt, showing the entire composition with multiple repetitions of the central flower motif arranged in a grid pattern and surrounded by a pink, scalloped border with green accents. The composition is orderly, grid-based, and highlights both a close-up segment and the whole design. Both decorative and structural quilting lines are visible throughout the drawing.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
